title: Android’s DIY widgets are a bit of vibe-coding fun
summary: Android's new "Create My Widget" feature, part of its Gemini Intelligence suite, allows Pixel users to generate custom home screen widgets using AI prompts. Currently in beta, this tool can quickly produce simple widgets displaying text, images, or triggering basic actions like opening an app or adding a calendar entry. While offering "vibe-coding fun" for personalized displays, the feature currently lacks advanced integration with real-time data, limiting its practical utility for complex tasks like displaying live bus arrival times.
